Name: Allnight
Description: An alchemical stimulant that prevents sleep and fatigue for 24 hours. After the effects wear off, the user must rest or suffer exhaustion.

Name: Angry Jack
Description: A stimulant that increases aggression and reduces pain sensitivity, making users more prone to violence.

Name: Bachelor Snuff
Description: Common snuff tobacco marketed to unmarried men, providing mild stimulation.

Name: Bamboo Palace
Description: An elaborate and expensive hookah made from bamboo and precious materials, often a status symbol among wealthy smokers.

Name: Belladonna
Description: Deadly nightshade, a poisonous plant. Can be used as a poison or in certain alchemical preparations. Highly toxic.

Name: Burglar's Torc
Description: A neck ornament favored by thieves, often enchanted to aid in stealth or provide other benefits to burglary.

Name: Clear Ear
Description: An alchemical substance that temporarily enhances hearing, allowing users to eavesdrop more effectively.

Name: False Ectoplasm
Description: Substance used by fraudulent mediums and spiritualists to fake supernatural manifestations during séances.

Name: Flayleaf
Description: An addictive drug that produces euphoria and relaxation. Long-term use leads to lethargy and dependency.

Name: Garlic
Description: Common herb believed to ward off vampires and evil. Also used in cooking and some folk remedies.

Name: Gaspodar's Signet
Description: A valuable and likely stolen signet ring, possibly bearing the seal of nobility or important organization.

Name: Heathensnuff
Description: Exotic snuff from foreign lands, often viewed with suspicion by conservative societies.

Name: Holly
Description: Sacred plant used in druidic rituals and as a spell component. Free if gathered in the wild.

Name: Hookah
Description: Water pipe for smoking tobacco or other substances. Often used in social settings.

Name: Leng Ruby
Description: A mysterious gemstone from the nightmare realm of Leng, highly valuable and possibly cursed.

Name: Mengkare's Shards
Description: Rare and valuable crystal shards, possibly of draconic origin, highly sought after on the black market.

Name: Mindburn Incense
Description: Incense that produces hallucinogenic effects when burned and inhaled, potentially dangerous to mental health.

Name: Mishan's Melodious Feather
Description: A rare and valuable feather, possibly from a magical creature, prized by collectors and spellcasters.

Name: Mistletoe
Description: Sacred plant used by druids as a spell focus. Free if gathered from oak trees with a golden sickle.

Name: Night Tea
Description: A mild stimulant tea that helps users stay awake, popular among guards and students.

Name: Pesh
Description: Highly addictive narcotic that enhances physical abilities but causes dependency and long-term health problems.

Name: Premium Hookah
Description: Exceptionally well-crafted hookah made from fine materials, a luxury item for the wealthy.

Name: Pump Organ
Description: Musical instrument, though sometimes associated with illicit establishments or used to cover illegal activities.

Name: Purity Test
Description: Alchemical kit for testing the quality and purity of drugs, poisons, or precious metals.

Name: Quieting Needles
Description: Acupuncture needles that can temporarily paralyze or silence victims, often used by assassins.

Name: Slave
Description: A person held in bondage. Slavery is illegal in many nations but persists in others. Average adult slave.

Name: Slave (hard labor)
Description: Strong slave suited for demanding physical work in mines, quarries, or construction.

Name: Slave (household)
Description: Slave trained for domestic work such as cooking, cleaning, or childcare.

Name: Slave (slip, halfling)
Description: Halfling slave, often used for tasks requiring small size or stealth. 'Slip' refers to their ability to move quietly.

Name: Slave (specialized)
Description: Slave with valuable skills such as literacy, artistic talent, or professional training.

Name: Snuffbox (bone or tortoise shell)
Description: Decorative box for carrying snuff tobacco, made from bone or tortoise shell.

Name: Snuffbox (ivory or precious metal)
Description: Luxury snuffbox crafted from ivory, gold, silver, or other precious materials.

Name: Snuffbox (tin or wood)
Description: Simple, functional snuffbox made from common materials.

Name: Songs of Shazathared
Description: Rare and forbidden tome containing dangerous knowledge, magical secrets, or heretical teachings. Highly illegal in most civilized lands.

Name: Tobacco
Description: Dried tobacco leaves for smoking in pipes, cigars, or hookahs. Also ground for use as snuff.

Name: Traveler's Hookah
Description: Portable, collapsible hookah designed for use while traveling, combining luxury with practicality.

Name: Wolfsbane
Description: Poisonous herb also known as aconite. Believed to have properties against werewolves and can be used as a poison component.
